correctness.rationale: Uniform escape gives an exact Poisson jump unraveling; Bessel displacement identities yield two weighted parity kernels with explicit Laplace transforms. Their strictly positive renewal operator has exactly one Perron root equal to one. Implicit expansion at zero tilt yields the stated drift and exact variance growth; full numerical density-matrix propagation agrees with the long-time slope to 1.01e-05 without reusing the renewal construction. Analytic renewal gives the SCGF and full real-tilt limit. No finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A period-two directional bias is a minimal physically motivated inhomogeneous environment, and equal escape rate is the natural solvable uniform-hazard class. Its classical directional anticorrelation suppresses diffusion without changing mean drift; the exact coherent correction and full SCGF quantify how unitary hopping destroys this environmental memory for a continuum of parameters, not a narrow arbitrary instance. This is a meaningful transport benchmark beyond known homogeneous dispersion.
